title: Service Test 19: Fill tube & fascia heater

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool/KitchenAid ACU French Door Refrigerator (W11509412A, ~27 cu ft)
source.oemTestTitle: Ice Maker Fill Tube and Fascia Heater Status

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. For live voltage checks, verify controls are off, use proper PPE, and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Diagnostics
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered at step 01. Press SW5/SW4 to navigate to the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW5 to move to the next step in the sequence. Press SW4 to back up.

steps.title: Navigate to Service Test 19
steps.body: In Service Diagnostics Mode, press SW5 to advance until the dispenser display shows 19. Press SW4 to go back. Amber Order Filter = step number; red Replace Filter = step result.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Test 19 — Fill tube and fascia heater

steps.title: Toggle fill tube/fascia heater
steps.body: Press SW3 to toggle ice maker fill tube heater and fascia heater (01=on, 02=off). P3-1 output energizes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press SW3 to toggle ice maker fill tube heater and fascia heater (01=on, 02=off). P3-1 output energizes.

steps.title: Fill tube heater warms
steps.body: With heaters on (01), does fill tube area warm within expected time? Check for ice blockage in tube.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With heaters on (01), does fill tube area warm within expected time? Check for ice blockage in tube.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Fill tube frozen or heater failed — common E4 dry-cycle path.

steps.title: Clear or replace fill tube heater
steps.oemOutcome: Clear frozen fill tube or replace fill tube/fascia heater assembly.

steps.title: Fill tube heater verified
steps.oemOutcome: Fill tube and fascia heater operate in service test 19.
